samples.summary: `runHunt` reads a `verdict` field off a runner observation that the runner never emits, so every reported UI finding's prediction verdict is "unknown"
samples.evidence: `scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:1096` builds `prediction: { ...expect, verdict: failing?.verdict ?? "unknown" }` where `failing = firstObservations?.[cand.failingIndex]` — an observation produced by `runUiPlan`. The runner's observation shape is fixed at `packages/frontend/scripts/hunt-ui-runner.mjs:373-383` and contains only `{index, action, ok, error, value, actual, actualError, oracles}`; it deliberately does NOT compare (see the comment at hunt-ui-runner.mjs:356: "The runner does NOT compare. It reports `actual` and nothing more"). The verdict is produced by `assessExpectation` and stored on the JOURNAL entry at `scripts/agent/hunt-ui-tool.mjs:373` (`entry.prediction = prediction`), which `runHunt` never consults for this field. Consequence: `renderUiReport`'s `- **prediction:** … — ${c.prediction.verdict}` line always renders `unknown` in a real run, and the replayed observation is never re-assessed by `assessExpectation` at all. The new test suite masks this because its fixture `FUNNEL_OBS` (scripts/agent/hunt-ui.test.mjs) hand-adds `verdict: "violated"` to observations — a property the real producer does not have.
searchedFor: grep verdict in hunt-ui-runner.mjs observation return

samples.summary: The unchanged header of `verify-hunt-oracles.mjs` still states that no `?fault=` query parameter and no test-only branch exist in the harness route — the very thing this change adds, in the file that now tests it
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/scripts/verify-hunt-oracles.mjs:14-16 reads: "Faults are injected from the DRIVER, never from application code. There is no `?fault=` query parameter and no test-only branch in the harness route — the page under test is the page that ships, and Playwright supplies the damage." The diff adds `?fault=drop-second-char`, a `KNOWN_FAULTS` registry and `installFault()` inside `packages/frontend/src/app/harness/hunt/page.tsx`, and adds `checkSeededFault`/`checkSeededFaultInServeMode` to this same file. `docs/design/harness-engineering.md:2029` was updated to record the reversal; this comment was not, so the file now contradicts itself top-to-bottom.

samples.summary: `hunt-ui.mjs run --fault` never validates the id at the CLI boundary; the downstream kebab-case guard throws inside the per-brief try/catch, so a typo silently produces a banner-marked "seeded" report with no fault ever injected
samples.evidence: `scripts/agent/hunt-ui.mjs:831` takes `--fault` verbatim (`const fault = strArg(args, "fault") ?? null;`) with no shape check, unlike the three downstream boundaries the diff adds (hunt-ui-runner.mjs:79, hunt-ui-probe.mjs `runUiPlan`, hunt-ui-session.mjs). `openUiSession` throws `fault must be a lowercase kebab-case id`, but that throw happens inside `exploreImpl(...)` which `runHunt` wraps in `try { … } catch (err) { … skipped.push({ kind: "session-failed" }) }`, so every brief is merely skipped. The run then still renders the "SEEDED RUN — NOT A HUNT" banner and still suppresses the ledger write, i.e. a positive control that reports it ran seeded while nothing was seeded — the exact class of failure the control exists to prevent. Validating at `cmdRun` (as the other three boundaries do) would make it a hard `fail()`.

samples.summary: New runtime coupling from `packages/frontend` into the repo-root `scripts/agent/` tree, via absolute-path dynamic import specifiers that no lint lane can see
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/scripts/verify-hunt-oracles.mjs:378-379 and :444 do `await import(`${repoRoot}/scripts/agent/hunt-ui-probe.mjs`)` etc. This is the first time the frontend workspace depends on repo-root agent code at runtime; because the specifier is a template literal, neither `eslint .` in packages/frontend nor `lint:arch` can see the boundary crossing. The absolute-path form is also POSIX-only — `import('C:\\…')` is not a valid ESM specifier — whereas the repo's only other cross-tree import (packages/frontend/scripts/build-font-catalog.mjs:24) uses `pathToFileURL`.
searchedFor: grep pathToFileURL and template-literal dynamic imports across *.mjs
